items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: And Rossano I met actually in Ascona, Switzerland where he was playing.

ctx.x: Sure. And then we go for tours elsewhere, but this city attracts players from everywhere. And Rossano I met actually in Ascona, Switzerland where he was playing. And I was in the press office, I was doing a little bit of — I had a little newspaper column and I wrote about the different acts and then I sat in and played a little bit. But he was playing there.
